description: Mobile: SVG wheel (MobileWheel.tsx) + Progressive haptics + Golden Ticket VIP (Tasks 5, 6, 8). Independent of FEAT-001/002/003. Covers all mobile changes plus the backend ticket endpoints. react-native-svg 15.15.4 is already installed. react-native-qrcode-svg needs to be installed via expo install.
steps: Create directory mobile-client/src/components/roulette/ if it does not exist.

Create mobile-client/src/components/roulette/MobileWheel.tsx: imports Svg, G, Path, Circle, Text as SvgText, Polygon from 'react-native-svg'. Import Animated from 'react-native'. Props: { drinks: RouletteDrinkDTO[], spinAnim: Animated.Value, size?: number }. Default size=280. AnimatedG = Animated.createAnimatedComponent(G). Compute segments: total=drinks.reduce(sum probability,0)||1. For each drink compute startAngle and sweepAngle in degrees. Function arcPath(cx,cy,r,startDeg,sweepDeg): convert to radians, compute x1=cx+r*cos(start), y1=cy+r*sin(start), x2=cx+r*cos(end), y2=cy+r*sin(end), largeArc=sweepDeg>180?1:0, return 'M cx cy L x1 y1 A r r 0 largeArc 1 x2 y2 Z'. Rarity color map: COMMON='#9b8f7d', RARE='#38BDF8', EPIC='#a855f7', LEGENDARY='#D4A340'. Use drink.color if it matches hex pattern, else use rarity color. Render: <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>. Center cx=cy=size/2. Wheel radius r=size/2-8. Hub radius=size/8. <AnimatedG style={{transform:[{rotate: spinAnim.interpolate({inputRange:[0,1],outputRange:['0deg','360deg']})}]}} origin={`${cx}, ${cy}`}>. For each segment: <Path d={arcPath(cx,cy,r,start,sweep)} fill={color} stroke='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' strokeWidth={1}/>. If sweepDeg>25: compute label angle midpoint, textX=cx+(r*0.65)*cos(labelAngle), textY=cy+(r*0.65)*sin(labelAngle), <SvgText x={textX} y={textY} fill='#ffffff' fontSize={size*0.035} textAnchor='middle' transform={`rotate(${labelAngleDeg+90}, ${textX}, ${textY})`}>{drink.name.slice(0,10)}</SvgText>. Hub: <Circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={size/8} fill='#1A1A22' stroke='#D4A340' strokeWidth={2}/>. </AnimatedG>. Pointer (outside AnimatedG, does not rotate): <Polygon points={`${cx-8},${8} ${cx+8},${8} ${cx},${28}`} fill='#D4A340'/>. </Svg>.

Modify mobile-client/src/screens/RouletteScreen.tsx (Task 5 part): import MobileWheel from '../components/roulette/MobileWheel'. In the heroSection JSX, replace the entire <Animated.View style={[styles.circleOuter, {borderColor, shadowColor, transform: spinState==='spinning'?[{rotate:rotateDeg}]:[]}]}><View style={styles.circleInner}>...</View></Animated.View> block with <MobileWheel drinks={drinks} spinAnim={rotateAnim} size={240}/>. The rotateAnim still drives both the border animation (now internal to MobileWheel) and the haptic timing. Remove the styles.circleOuter and styles.circleInner style entries (or leave them dead, clean up not required). Keep all other logic (handleSpin, result card, history, footer) unchanged.

Modify mobile-client/src/screens/RouletteScreen.tsx (Task 6 haptics): replace the fixed-interval haptic block in handleSpin. Current code: hapticIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => { if(hapticCount>=20){clearInterval...} hapticCount++; try{Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light}catch{} }, 80). Replace with a progressive haptic sequence: use three consecutive setTimeout calls chained: Phase1 (0-1000ms): setInterval at 60ms, ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light. After 1000ms clearInterval+start Phase2. Phase2 (1000-2200ms): setInterval at 120ms, ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light. After 1200ms clearInterval+start Phase3. Phase3 (2200-3000ms): setInterval at 220ms, ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium. After 800ms clearInterval. Store timeout refs to clear on component unmount. When result arrives from spinPublicRoulette: call Haptics.impactAsync(ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy) immediately. Set spinState to 'revealing' briefly (500ms timeout) then to 'result'. The 'revealing' state should show a visual deceleration cue in the wheel (the rotateAnim loop continues but slows: stop the Animated.loop and run a final Animated.timing with easing Easing.out(Easing.cubic) over 500ms to a final angle).
Install react-native-qrcode-svg in mobile: run `cd mobile-client && npx expo install react-native-qrcode-svg` in the workspace terminal.

Create mobile-client/src/components/roulette/GoldenTicket.tsx: imports QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg'. Props: { ticket:string, expiresAt:number, drinkName:string, rarity:string, onClose:()=>void }. State: remainingMs=expiresAt-Date.now(). useEffect with setInterval(1000): update remainingMs. When <=0 clear interval. Format as mm:ss: Math.floor(remainingMs/60000)+':'+(Math.floor((remainingMs%60000)/1000)).toString().padStart(2,'0'). Modal-style full-screen View with backgroundColor='rgba(0,0,0,0.95)'. Inner card: borderWidth=2, borderColor='#D4A340', borderRadius=24, padding=24, backgroundColor='#0F0F14', alignItems='center'. Rarity badge at top. drinkName in large gold text. QRCode: value={ticket}, size={200}, color='#D4A340', backgroundColor='#0F0F14'. Countdown text: remainingMs>0?`Válido por ${formatted}`:'TICKET EXPIRADO' in red. When expired: QRCode opacity=0.3. Bottom close button: TouchableOpacity with text 'Cerrar'.
Add TICKET_SECRET to backend/.env: append line TICKET_SECRET=bartender-roulette-hmac-secret-2024 (placeholder — user should change in prod).

Create backend/src/controllers/rouletteTicket.controller.js (ES Module): import crypto from 'crypto'. import { ok, badRequest } from '../utils/response.js'. const SECRET = process.env.TICKET_SECRET ?? 'bartender-ticket-secret'. const TTL_MS = 30*60*1000. function sign(payload){ return crypto.createHmac('sha256',SECRET).update(JSON.stringify(payload)).digest('hex'); }. export async function generateTicket(req,res){ const {drinkId,rarity,drinkName,tableId}=req.body; if(!drinkId||!rarity) return badRequest(res,'drinkId y rarity son requeridos'); const now=Date.now(); const payload={drinkId,drinkName:drinkName??'',rarity,tableId:tableId??null,iat:now,exp:now+TTL_MS}; const sig=sign(payload); return ok(res,{ticket:JSON.stringify({...payload,sig}),expiresAt:payload.exp}); }. export async function redeemTicket(req,res){ const {ticket}=req.body; if(!ticket) return badRequest(res,'ticket requerido'); try{ const parsed=JSON.parse(ticket); const {sig,...payload}=parsed; if(Date.now()>payload.exp) return badRequest(res,'Ticket expirado'); const expected=sign(payload); const sigBuf=Buffer.from(sig,'hex'); const expBuf=Buffer.from(expected,'hex'); if(sigBuf.length!==expBuf.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(sigBuf,expBuf)) return badRequest(res,'Ticket inválido'); return ok(res,{valid:true,drink:{id:payload.drinkId,name:payload.drinkName,rarity:payload.rarity}}); }catch{ return badRequest(res,'Ticket malformado'); } }.

Modify backend/src/routes/roulette.routes.js: add import { generateTicket, redeemTicket } from '../controllers/rouletteTicket.controller.js' at top. Add routes after the public routes block: router.post('/generate-ticket', protect, generateTicket); router.post('/redeem-ticket', ...adminOnly, redeemTicket);

Modify mobile-client/src/screens/RouletteScreen.tsx (ticket integration): import GoldenTicket from '../components/roulette/GoldenTicket'. Add state: ticketData:{ticket:string,expiresAt:number}|null = null. Import a ticket API function (create inline fetch call or add to rouletteApi.ts: POST /roulette/generate-ticket with {drinkId:selectedDrink._id, rarity:selectedDrink.rarity, drinkName:selectedDrink.name, tableId}). In the result card resultActions section, add a new NButton with label='🎫 Generar Ticket VIP' and onPress that calls the API and sets ticketData. Render {ticketData && <GoldenTicket ticket={ticketData.ticket} expiresAt={ticketData.expiresAt} drinkName={selectedDrink.name} rarity={selectedDrink.rarity} onClose={()=>setTicketData(null)}/>} as an overlay above the SafeAreaView content.
